// purpose: Declaration-only emit over the staged html/ closure, so packages/web ships
generated .d.ts instead of hand-written shims that can drift from html/.
Run by scripts/build.mjs between the vendor and bundle stages; never run
rootDir is the package root because two trees are compiled: staging/ (the
vendored html/ closure) and src/ (the framework wrappers, which are authored
here and have no html/ counterpart). Declarations therefore land under
dist/types/staging/ and dist/types/src/, mirroring where they came from.
checkJs is off on purpose: html/tsconfig.json already type-checks these same
modules with checkJs+strict as the `npm run typecheck` gate. Repeating that
here would just report the same errors twice, against copies.
projectm-render-worker.js is excluded because it is a *classic* worker, not
a module: its top-level `let Module` is a script-scope global that collides
with the `declare var Module` in projectm-host-types.ts. It exports nothing,
so there is no declaration to emit, and html/tsconfig.worker.json already
type-checks it in the right (worker) lib context.
